credits.heading: Design & development
credits.text: seige2222 is an independently developed worker-colony simulation. Game concept and creative direction: site815. Project implementation and original procedural art developed with Codex and Claude. Rex is based on the owner's golden retriever.

credits.heading: Engine & creation tools
credits.text: SEIGE 2222 uses Unreal® Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and elsewhere. Unreal® Engine, Copyright 1998 – 2026, Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved. Original industrial structures, workers and aliens created with Blender. Licensed nature models prepared in Blender. Blender is a trademark of the Blender Foundation.

credits.heading: Nature and surfaces / Poly Haven / CC0 1.0
credits.text: Fir Tree 01 and Fern 02: Rob Tuytel and Rico Cilliers. Tree Small 02: Rico Cilliers. Rock Moss Set 01: Kless Gyzen. Bark Brown 02 and Brown Mud Dry: Rob Tuytel. Grass Ground and Leafy Grass: Charlotte Baglioni. Rock Boulder Dry: Dimitrios Savva and Rico Cilliers.

credits.heading: Mature woodland and meadow / CC0 1.0
credits.text: Jacaranda Tree: Rico Cilliers, with guidance from Rob Tuytel. Grass Bermuda 01 and Grass Medium 02: Rico Cilliers. Forest Leaves 02: Rob Tuytel. Models and photographic maps: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com/license). Grass 004 procedural PBR surface: Lennart Demes / ambientCG (docs.ambientcg.com/license). These sources permit commercial use and redistribution. Original wildflower geometry authored for this project in Blender. Development asset tool: Powered by Poly Haven.

credits.heading: Asset provenance
credits.text: Nature models and their PBR maps are CC0 and permit commercial use. Rex is the separate provisional exception described below. Creator credits, source links, licenses and file hashes are retained with the project. All game assets are local; no runtime downloads.

credits.heading: Rex / provisional asset — licence unresolved
credits.text: Based on the owner's Rex photographs. Base geometry generated with Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.1; Blender rig, animation and photo coat prepared for seige2222. Restored for the owner's prototype review. Its licence excludes use of outputs in the EU, UK and South Korea. Attribution does not resolve this restriction; distribution clearance remains outstanding. Source: huggingface.co/tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.1/blob/main/LICENSE.

credits.heading: Original audio / CC0 1.0
credits.text: Original synthesized sound effects — seige2222, CC0-1.0; generated offline in Tools/create_original_audio.py (no third-party recordings).

build_groups.name: Extraction
build_groups.description: One Extraction Mine fits any deposit. Its output is fixed by the resource beneath the site.

build_groups.name: Production
build_groups.description: Physical ingredients and electricity are consumed per transaction; some recipes produce multiple goods.

build_groups.name: Energy
build_groups.description: Solar generation, fuel and fusion power, and grid battery storage. Roads connect consumers to the shared grid.

build_groups.name: Logistics
build_groups.description: Road grids, cargo, workers and trade. Wall: click joints, E flips inside/outside, Enter commits, Backspace undoes; Delete removes a selected segment.

build_groups.name: Defense
build_groups.description: Automatic laser, kinetic, missile and plasma defenses; configurable wheeled, tracked and mech production.
